parakeet: A true Messiah would crush that power, not cozy up to it. The reality is, Jesus told people to pay taxes to Caesar. He submitted to Roman execution. And later, Rome adopted him as their own, not because he threatened them, but because he didn't. The Jewish Messiah was expected to break empire. Jesus was absorbed by it, and his image became a tool of it.
